items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-01-27
items.q: What about Roy, that fellow from California

ctx.x: What I want to do, what you going to do? Just sit there and die, that's what you going to do. That's all you going to do, you know what I mean? Once you sit there, that's it. You know what I mean? So, as long as the man can give you the life and help, keep it going, you know what I mean? Just keep going, it's good to be going, you know what I mean? Good to go, you know what I mean? So, that's how I feel about it, you know what I mean? I'm not looking for the hard way, you know what I mean? To do the hard way, you…

What about Roy, that fellow from California, can anybody learn how to play a drum or a horn? What do you mean? Can just anybody off the street learn how to play? You think anybody can learn how to play? Well, I tell you, sometimes a fellow don't have it.

He try hard enough. You know a fellow told me about his kid. That fellow told me about his kid not long ago, you see? He bought a certain drum for his kid. He said, oh, he really tried. You know what I mean? He said he really liked it, but he tried with somebody and he couldn't make it. I said, well, but he gave up too quick. You got to keep at it, you know what I mean? You got to have interesting things when you do things, you know what I mean? See? And you got to do one thing at a time, you know. You can't do…
